category: anonymous file and note sharing page

free_tier.stated: Free, no signup: a single file up to 10 GB, or a stack of files bundled into one link.
free_tier.notes: The page states a 10 GB limit per file or bundle; no total storage quota or monthly allowance is stated.

per_object_cap.stated: Up to 10 GB per single file; a bundle of files is 10 GB in total.

retention.stated: The sender chooses the expiry, from 1 day up to 30 days; files are permanently deleted after it.

egress.terms: No download byte allowance is stated; a share can carry a sender-set download or view limit and an expiry of up to 30 days.

interface_detail: Client-rendered page; the served HTML is 6 193 bytes with no form and no API path. /api/upload and /upload answer 404.
tooling: Browser only as observed; nothing to drive from a script without reading the JS bundle.
chaining: A 10 GB drop plus encrypted notes is a hand-off; with no published expiry it cannot be scheduled against.

limits.value: 10 GB per file or per bundle

limits_note: Everything beyond the title had to be inferred from a client-rendered page, which is why this record is unverified rather than documented.
binding_note: The 10 GB per-file or per-bundle limit is the only limit the page states; no total quota, monthly allowance or download cap is published.

identity_cost.detail: 'Zero accounts or sign-ups required'; no subscription is offered.

reliability_note: The page is a JS application that serves no readable offer; the operator is unnamed.
confidence_note: The page body states the 10 GB limit, the 1 to 30 day expiry and the no-signup claim. No upload or download was attempted, so nothing is measured and the API shape is unknown.
